Resolves #3602

Adds the `data.Store -> data.Model` companion class generation path in `buildScripts/create/class.mjs` (completing the symmetric pair with `#3255` / `PR #20232`'s `data.Model -> data.Store` flow) and makes the top-level `baseClass === 'data.Store'` block the single store→model resolver:
- Adds `-M, --createModel <value>` (`'yes'` | `'no'`) to `buildScripts/create/class.mjs` (`neo-cc`) and prompts `Do you want to create a matching data.Model?` (when `!isDrop` and no matching `data.Model` file exists on disk at either `<modelClassFolder>/<modelName>.mjs` or beside the store at `<classFolder>/<modelName>.mjs`).
- Singularizes the store class name (`-ies` → `-y`, trailing `-s` → singular), maps the namespace (`store` → `model`, or `[...ns, 'model']`), generates the companion `data.Model` file when `createModel === 'yes'`, and passes `modelFile` and `modelName` into `createClass()` so the generated `data.Store` imports and binds the model (with `createClass`'s existing `while (importName === baseFileName || importName === file)` loop aliasing `Store` → `StoreModel`).

`agent-preflight`: not hosted here; baseline `PR Baseline` jobs run in CI.

Evidence: L2 (Playwright unit tests in `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/createClassModelStore.spec.mjs` exercising `buildScripts/create/class.mjs` CLI execution and `node --check` syntax verification across `-M yes`, `-M no`, `-ies` singularization, root/nested namespaces, `Store` → `StoreModel` collision disambiguation, and existing sibling model detection) → L2 required (no structured ACs on #3602).

## AC Evidence
No structured ACs on #3602.

| Requirement (#3602) | Verification |
|---|---|
| Prompt to create a matching `data.Model` when generating a `data.Store` via `create-class` (`-M, --createModel <value>`) and wire the resolved or generated model into the store | `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/createClassModelStore.spec.mjs` (`6` tests in `#3602` describe block, `11/11` passing across the spec file) |

## Deltas from ticket
- Added `-M, --createModel <value>` CLI flag alongside interactive prompt for non-interactive CLI/test usage, mirroring `-m, --createStore <value>` from `#3255` (`PR #20232`).
- Unified store→model resolution into the top-level `baseClass === 'data.Store'` block (checking both `<modelClassFolder>/<modelName>.mjs` and `<classFolder>/<modelName>.mjs` beside the store) and retired `createClass`'s duplicate `else` derivation.

## Test Evidence
All coverage runs in CI.

## Post-Merge Validation
- [ ] None required; covered by unit tests in CI.

Authored by Maryam (Gemini 4 Argon, Antigravity). Session f6c28a82-1400-4f2c-9d74-e81b65cb73d8. 🧭
